$comment: Zone rulesets for the 33audio shop once it is on a custom domain in a Cloudflare zone. Apply with: node security/waf/apply.mjs (dry run) or --apply. Each phase entrypoint is replaced as a whole.

rules.description: Let verified AI crawlers read the discovery files without later custom rules interfering
Block scanner paths for software this static site does not run
rules.expression: (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, ".php") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/wp-") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.env") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/.git") or http.request.uri.path contains "/cgi-bin/")

rules.description: The Stripe webhook only accepts POST with a Stripe-Signature header
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/stripe-webhook" and (http.request.method ne "POST" or not any(len(http.request.headers["stripe-signature"][*]) gt 0)))

rules.description: Read-only API routes take GET and HEAD only
Orders ship to the USA only, so challenge checkout attempts from elsewhere
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/checkout" and http.request.method eq "POST" and ip.src.country ne "US")

rules.description: Challenge likely automated checkout traffic. Needs Bot Management (Enterprise); leave disabled on other plans and use Bot Fight Mode instead.
rules.expression: (http.request.uri.path eq "/api/checkout" and cf.bot_management.score lt 30 and not cf.bot_management.verified_bot)

rules.description: Workers AI costs money per call: limit /api/search per client and data center. Fits the Free plan (10 s period and timeout).
Limit checkout session creation. A second rate limiting rule needs the Pro plan or higher.
